dag.description: End-to-end PyTorch pipeline with percentile score calibration: train a PyTorch classifier on a Cradle training split, tabular-preprocess a separate Cradle calibration split, evaluate the model on that holdout via PyTorchModelEval, map raw scores to percentile buckets via PercentileModelCalibration, then Package, build Payload, and Register a model that emits a score-percentile output variable. Direct PyTorch analog of xgboost_percentile_e2e (no tokenizer and no stratified-sampling stage).

agent_context.when_to_use: Deploy a PyTorch (deep-learning) classifier whose raw scores must be mapped to percentile buckets for downstream threshold-based decisioning. Train on a Cradle training split, hold out a separate Cradle calibration split for PyTorchModelEval, and register a model that emits a score-percentile NUMERIC output variable. Fits abuse-detection models such as abuse_polygraph (ContactEvaluation / PolygraphModel), atoz_bsm_pytorch and atoz_nexus_pytorch (AtoZ-claims Buyer-Seller-Messaging).
agent_context.when_not_to_use: Use pytorch complete_e2e if you need standard probability calibration (ModelCalibration / isotonic-Platt) instead of percentile bucketing. Use pytorch_tokenizer_percentile_e2e if a learned TokenizerTraining stage is required before PyTorchTraining. Use pytorch_stratified_percentile_e2e if class imbalance requires a StratifiedSampling stage. Use xgboost_percentile_e2e for a tabular-only tree model with the same percentile shape.
differentiators: Vanilla PyTorch + percentile calibration e2e - no tokenizer and no stratified-sampling stage
PyTorchModelEval on a dedicated Cradle calibration split feeds PercentileModelCalibration (score -> percentile bucket mapping)
Direct PyTorch analog of xgboost_percentile_e2e: identical 10-node / 11-edge topology with PyTorch swapped for XGBoost
Registration emits a score-percentile NUMERIC output variable consumed by downstream rules

prerequisites.check: Two Cradle SQL sources (training split + disjoint calibration split)
prerequisites.how: Cradle profiles for the training window and a separate holdout/calibration window
ml.g5.xlarge+ available in the target account/region
PercentileModelCalibration config lists the percentile cut points

safe_defaults: percentile_buckets follow team default cut points
common_pitfalls: Calibration data must be a separate holdout/temporal split, not the training split
PercentileModelCalibration consumes PyTorchModelEval_calibration output, not PyTorchTraining directly
Package takes PyTorchTraining output while the percentile calibration artifact is wired into Registration

pytorch_and_percentile_scores?.no: Use xgboost_percentile_e2e (tabular) or pytorch complete_e2e (probability calibration)
